hooks.command: FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); [[ "$FILE" =~ \.(ts|tsx)$ ]] || exit 0; cd /Users/allanpinheiro/helper; if [[ "$FILE" == *"/electron/"* ]]; then OUT=$(pnpm tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json --noEmit 2>&1 | head -20); else OUT=$(pnpm tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -20); fi; [[ -z "$OUT" ]] && exit 0; jq -n --arg ctx "TS errors after edit:\n$OUT" '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":$ctx}}'
